title: Deion Sanders takes subtle jab at ex-wife Pilar in Colorado team meeting - NewsBreak
text: Deion Sanders has never been shy about speaking his mind, but his latest jab was aimed at a familiar figure from his past. The Colorado Buffaloes coach has mentioned his ex-wife Pilar Sanders before. While much of the media attention lately has focused on the transition to the NFL for Shilo and Shedeur Sanders, Coach Prime reminded everyone that when it comes to drama, he still holds the crown. The 58-year-old celebrated his birthday over the weekend, but that wasn't his cause for letting everyone know he was excited. During a team gathering, Colorado offensive coordinator Pat Shurmur mentioned that Sunday marked his 35th wedding anniversary. Without missing a beat, Deion responded, “Sunday was my celebration of my second divorce,” drawing loud laughter from the room and pumping his fist in mock triumph. The jab may have been lighthearted, but it was a clear reminder of just how public and personal his past remains. Deion was married to Pilar for over a decade and is the mother of his three youngest children, Shilo, Shedeur, and Shelomi. It was clear the two have avoided crossing paths at Colorado games, despite Pilar regularly attending to support their kids. Coach Prime walked his boys midway during senior day last year before skipping out after seeing Pilar. He nearly high-stepped his way to the sideline. In contrast to the humor, Sanders also showed his softer side throughout his health issues. He's also been linked to dating Karrueche Tran, who was spotted at his bedside during his bladder cancer battle. However, both sides have denied any sort of rumors. Related: Shedeur Sanders' mom steals spotlight with scorching outfit at son's NFL debut As Shilo and Shedeur pursue NFL dreams, it's clear to see the influence from both parents remains strong. Pilar was in Charlotte to encourage Shedeur as he got his first NFL start against the Carolina Panthers last Friday. Deion’s message to Shedeur after his first NFL game was heartfelt and a reminder to trust in God and make people remember the 'Sanders' name. Related: Deion Sanders reveals his words for Shedeur's pregame walk Coach Prime enters his third season at Colorado ready to make a statement for the first time without his sons on the roster.
